subject: MediaWave renewal: request to increase hosted commit and clarify rate bands
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@mediawave.com>
To: soojin_lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-17T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-trial usage spike and next-term commit questions

Hi Soojin —

Thanks again for the trial ramp support. Over the last 6 weeks our integration has steadily increased traffic; attached is a short usage extract (usage_report_apr_may.csv) showing the spike during our test campaigns. We expect this to be sustained into production.

Two asks as we head toward renewal (term starts in ~45 days):
1) We’d like to increase monthly hosted commit from 10M tokens to 40M tokens (phased over the first 3 months). Can you outline pricing tiers for that uplift and any volume discounts?
2) We noticed occasional soft throttling at peak 99th pct. Can you confirm what the rate-limit bands look like for the new commit levels and whether we can get higher per-second concurrency before a soft throttle?

Also, procurement will want a simple SOW and a runbook for fallback behavior if capacity is constrained. If you can share a draft SOW and any DocuSign link, I’ll loop procurement.

Appreciate a quick plan — can you do a call tomorrow afternoon?

Best,
Elena
Elena Rossi
VP Engineering, MediaWave

Elena — thanks for the data, and congrats on the successful ramp. Quick reply with a proposed approach and next steps below.

High-level proposal (summary):
- Phased commit uplift: 10M -> 20M (month 1), 20M -> 30M (month 2), 30M -> 40M (month 3).
- Unit pricing: tiered rate bands with blended discount for 12-month term. I’ve asked Sales to confirm exact $/1K-token bands but expect ~8-12% off list at 40M.
- Rate limits / soft throttle: we can raise per-second concurrency ceiling for the MediaWave pool (recommended) and add a 10% burst credit bucket that prevents hard throttles during short spikes.

Attachments: commit_cheatsheet.pdf (details on rate bands, recommended concurrency, and suggested batching). I’ve also drafted a short SOW (will attach updated file after pricing confirmation).

Next steps:
1) Quick sync with Karthik to lock pricing and discount structure.
2) Ops review to confirm concurrency ceiling and burst credits (Vanessa + Jordan).
3) I’ll send a formal SOW + DocuSign once we confirm final numbers — target by EOD tomorrow.

Can you do a 30-min call 2027-06-17 at 4:00pm PT? If that works I’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks,

Soojin — thanks for the ping and forwarding the usage. Recommendations below (pricing + commercial structure).

Commercial proposal (high-level):
- Term: 12 months. Start: agreed renewal date.
- Commit schedule: 10M (historic) -> 20M -> 30M -> 40M over first 90 days.
- Unit rates (blended example for planning):
  - 0-5M: $0.015 / 1K tokens
  - 5M-20M: $0.012 / 1K tokens
  - 20M-40M: $0.0095 / 1K tokens
- Introductory concession: 10% off blended unit price for first 6 months if signed within 30 days.
- Burst credits: include 20M tokens of burst credits usable across first three months to smooth cutover.
- SLA / Ops: propose standard Hosted SLA with a dedicated escalation path; ops to provide runbook for throttling and emergency fallbacks.

If Ops confirms concurrency ceiling + burst mechanism is safe, I’m ok with progressing. I’ll prepare a pricing attachment and Draft SOW for signature (MediaWave SOW v1).

Karthik
Head of Sales | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com

On compatibility: Vanessa / Jordan — please confirm the concurrency ceiling you are comfortable assigning to MediaWave, and whether the burst credit bucket should be per-tenant or per-region. If not ready now, a targeted ops runbook and guardrail checklist will suffice for procurement.
